x: Once again we missed our middle order runners (ill, buying houses and injured) and then we had Roger Alsop, Kevin Nash, Alex Hutchinson and Clive Gilby in action at Cardiff the following day so had to go back to the 60s to close in.
It was good to see Alex Hutchinson racing for Belgrave and with Kevin Nash and Roger Alsop to back up, an unlooked for team win came our way.

Stage 8: Racing in Belgrave colours for the first time, Canadian international Alex Hutchinson relentlessly ran down both teams ahead. Still not at his fittest, Alex's 16:55 was the day's 7th best and right at the end of the stage with only 30 metres remaining he had the Belgrave fans leaping up and…
Canadian Alex Hutchinson, fastest on his stage and 7th best short leg of the day took Belgrave into the lead with the last few paces of his stage.

Soon after Paul added good points in the 1500m while in the 'A' race, Alex Hutchinson ran his last race for the season to place 5th. But the icing on the cake was the steeplechase, where not only did Kevin Nash return from illness but Justin Chaston, looking splendidly fit, front ran to an easy win.
